title: paid in footprints for your own to-do list
caption:
this app pays you in footprints for doing your own to-do list 🤫

Finish tasks, walk, or write a line in your diary and footprints add up. Spend them on furniture for the room your charms live in. Daily Charm is free to start on the App Store (iPhone).

The person in this video is AI-generated.

#cozyapps #todolist #dailyplanner #productivity #dailycharm

end.line: Free to start on the App Store
